sam_infer: Quick heads-up — after the runtime deploy on prod-dedicated we're seeing occasional +Inf in softmax on the fused+paged flash fp8 path. Small fraction but reproducible with a repro set.

anjali: Ugh. Any trace or sample inputs?

sam_infer: Minimal dump attached inline:
```
model: transformer-xl-v2
kernel: fused_paged_flash_v2_fp8
seq_len: 1024
batch: 4
kv_cached: true
input_scale: 1.2e-2
logits_slice: [ 1.23, 0.48, -inf, 0.31 ]
stack ctx: tiled page boundary during KV merge
```

mark_r: Does this hit bf16/fp16 too or only fp8 quant path?

sam_infer: Only fp8 so far. bf16/fp16 look fine on same inputs. Also seems correlated with KV warmup + our batch-merge heuristic (we merge when prefix>512 && batch>2).

anjali: I profiled one failing run with nvprof — saw the exp() step saturating on one warp after the tile merge. Looks like the max-reduction was missed when a tile straddled a paged boundary.

sam_infer: Exactly. The fused kernel assumes contiguous tile max reduction before applying exp(scale*(scores - max)), but when we stitch tiles across pages the reduction path isn't executed for the stitched segment. Leads to huge exponents and +Inf after accumulation.

perf-bot: Perf alert: tail-latency +12% for seq>512 on kernel fused_paged_flash_v2_fp8 (sampled at 0.12%). See alert #PR-2181. :warning:

devops_lea: We should hotfix selector to avoid the fused fp8 variant on paged-boundary cases until we patch. Rollback plan?

mark_r: Patch ideas: 1) add an inline per-tile max-reduce before exp, 2) clamp the exp arg to a safe range (e.g. clamp(x, -80, 80)), 3) modify batching heuristic to avoid merging KV segments that cause tile_cross=true. All three together is safe.

anjali: I'll open a PR with (1) as the kernel safety fix + unit test that fabricates extreme positive logits. Also add a selector guard that prefers non-fused flash variant if page_boundary_merge==true.

sam_infer: Repro steps for QA:
1) start dedicated node with model transformer-xl-v2 (quant fp8).
2) feed long prefix ~600 tokens to warm KV, then send a batch of 4 short continuations.
3) ensure batch-merge heuristic triggers (prefix>512 && batch>2).
4) observe softmax logits for any +Inf or NaN.

mark_r: Good. I'll add a perf test to the nightly bench that scans for inf/nan on fp8 kernels with paged boundaries.

devops_lea: I'll coordinate a quick selector rollback for the next deploy window if the fix isn't ready.

anjali: PR draft incoming in ~30m. tagging @sam_infer for repro artifacts.

sam_infer: Thanks — added the failing input set to /repros/fp8_softmax_inf_2181234567 and a perf trace. Will follow up with logs. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: Incident bookmark created: incidents/2181234567-softmax-fp8-paged-inf.
